own_solution.law: Conservation of momentum in a perfectly inelastic collision; KE lost = (1/2) mu v_rel^2 with mu = m1 m2/(m1+m2)

defect_reasons.other: For T081E it is not stated whether the 4 m/s is the skater's speed after picking up the bag (giving 72 kg at 4 m/s, 459.18 J) or before (momentum conservation gives 3.33 m/s, loss 369.39 J); the present-tense description favours the former.

notes: Base: mu = 60*75/135 = 33.333 kg, loss = 0.5*33.333*25 = 416.67 J (check: KE_i = 817.5 J, KE_f = 108225/270 = 400.83 J). With bag on the east skater (72 kg at 4 m/s): mu = 5400/147 = 36.735 kg, loss = 459.18 J. Coach and earlier-outing sentences are disconnected. Numbered sentences all state 12 kg; 'small bag' sentences carry no number.
